evidence.quote: The following tuition fees apply for the 2026-2027 academic year.

notes: Tuition: The Dutch page 'Studiekosten' (https://www.avans.nl/studeren/praktische-zaken/studiekosten) lists tuition of €2,694 (wettelijk) and €10,308 (instellingscollegegeld) for 2026-2027 without tying the amount to full-time bachelor or non-EU; because the English page (https://www.avans.nl/en/int/studying/practical-information/tuition-fees) explicitly identifies €10,308 as the institutional fee for Non-EEA nationality for bachelor's and master's degree students in 2026-2027, that amount was used. Programme duration: The programme page states 'Duur 4 jaar, voltijd bachelor', so durationYears is 4. Teaching language: The programme page states 'Taal Nederlands', so teachingLanguages is ['nl']. Documents: Only the DigiD registration is required; the pages do not list specific academic documents for international applicants. Intakes: The programme page states 'Startmaand September' but no year, so no intake dates are given. Application channel: The pages mention Studielink for enrollment but do not specify it as the application channel for international applicants.

note.fr: Les étudiants non-EEE doivent s'inscrire avant le 1er mai.
note.en: Non-EEA students must apply by May 1st.

evidence.quote: Students with a non-EEA nationality are required to apply by May 1st and to pay their tuition fees in full prior to the start of the academic year.
